name: task_discovery_panel_v1
purpose: Outcome-blind model-assisted discovery and review of candidate evaluation tasks; executable qualification remains authoritative.

candidate_sources.decision: Do not integrate: a dedicated evaluation GPU cannot be assumed available.
Do not integrate: the one-shot anchor role is unnecessary alongside existing coverage.

review_protocol.calibration_pilot: All three reviewers independently review every candidate.
review_protocol.scaled_batches: Assign a rotating primary and validator by stable hash; send disagreements and every high-risk task to the third reviewer. Balance assignments so every reviewer serves in every role.
review_protocol.reviewer_isolation: Reviewers receive the same public task packet and cannot read another review before submitting their own.
review_protocol.adjudication: The third review resolves classification disagreements only. It cannot waive a hard gate or mechanical failure.
public_input_allowlist: public task statement and API contract
declared language, toolchain, and verifier command
source revision, task metadata, provenance, and license
task taxonomy and environment resource declaration

mechanical_qualification.authority: Executable checks and recorded artifacts override every model recommendation.
required: pinned source, dataset, image, toolchain, and verifier revisions
agent workspace excludes hidden tests, gold artifacts, future history, and prior outcomes
null fails target checks for the intended reason with no model patch
gold passes target checks without regressions
three clean observations per null and gold condition
cold and warm setup and verifier timing
failure taxonomy separates setup, image, verifier, budget, transport, incorrect, and resolved
license permits the intended use and manifest distribution
mechanical_qualification.timing_domains: GPU/performance tasks additionally pin GPU model, clocks, driver, framework, contention policy, warmup, repetitions, and noise thresholds.

decision_policy.nomination: Model reviews nominate tasks for mechanical qualification; they do not qualify tasks.
decision_policy.disagreement: Retain all raw reviews and the adjudication reason. Do not collapse disagreement into an unexplained majority vote.
decision_policy.acceptance: A task enters an evaluation manifest only after every hard gate passes. Reviewer consensus cannot rescue a failed gate.
decision_policy.reporting: Publish per-domain/source results and reviewer disagreement diagnostics; never blend domains into one capability score.
